messages:
Ivy: tiny poll — what's one small thing you do that makes your day better (5 minutes or less)? curious for ideas.
Marcus: brew a proper cup of coffee and take 2 mins to watch the steam. oddly grounding.
Tala: quick window stare: 3 deep breaths, look outside. resets my brain.
Ben: five pushups when I wake up. tiny but satisfying.
Hana: swap one email reply for a short walk outside. movement + fresh air = win.
Marcus: @Hana that feels like a mini win loop.
Ivy: anyone do a creative micro-task? doodle, haiku, anything like that?
Tala: 1-line haiku at lunch. keeps me practicing without pressure.
Ben: chip-bot, remind me to do 5 pushups at 9am tomorrow please :sweat_smile:
chip-bot: Reminder set for Ben: "5 pushups" tomorrow at 09:00.
Hana: ok challenge: pick one of these for this week and report back on Friday. who	's in?
Marcus: in. starting coffee mindfulness tomorrow.
Ivy: joining with window breaths. thanks for the ideas everyone! :sparkles:
